records.subject: Welcome aboard, Harbor Systems
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no tickets, and zero replies to two Wrenfield emails ([email:7d5d7ff4], [email:17e5ebcb]). No signal of engagement; Starter solo account. Unaided activation in the remaining 8 days is unlikely but not impossible.

draft.subject: Getting Harbor Systems started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Checking in since your Wrenfield signup last week. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the best place to start — the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything about how your team works.

Best,
Chidi
